title: astragalus lambertii var. bigelovii
intro: Astragalus lambertii var. bigelovii, commonly known as Bigelow's milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. This perennial herb is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States, particularly in the Rocky Mountains and surrounding areas. The health benefits of Bigelow's milkvetch include its immunomodulatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as isoflavones, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties.
